Reason: the consuming app adopts @gravity-ui/icons as the iconset; the
hand-drawn 16x16 pixel grids are replaced wholesale and the icon library
must be fully vendored (no npm dependency).
Change: vendored the complete @gravity-ui/icons v2.21.0 svgs/ set (799
files, MIT, byte-identical to the upstream tag) plus LICENSE and a
VENDORED.md provenance note under icons/gravity/. PixelIcon keeps its
name, props and icon vocabulary but now maps each name onto a Gravity
SVG inlined via ?raw import (nearest semantic neighbour where no literal
counterpart exists: bulldoze->eraser, crane->cubes-3-overlap,
minimap->compass, grid->layout-cells, table->layout-header-cells,
inspect->target, tree->folder-tree, build->hammer, siren->megaphone).
Vocabulary additions: chevrons-left, chevrons-right, square-fill —
promoting Pagination's and Menu's private glyphs into the registry —
plus dice (dice-5) and shuffle for the consuming app's reseed/randomize
controls;
their glyphs.tsx files and the retired pixel-grid glyph modules are
deleted. Pagination and Menu render through PixelIcon.
Upstream: candidate
